facts.fact: The cathedral is an active church; funerals, weddings and other religious events close tourist visits.
facts.excerpt: We are closed for touring during funerals, weddings, and other religious events.

facts.fact: The operator does not sell entry tickets; a donation is distinct from an admission ticket.
facts.excerpt: No tickets are required to visit or tour the Cathedral. We do not sell tickets.

facts.fact: The captured operator notice announces Thanksgiving November26 closure; no opening on that holiday is promised.
facts.excerpt: We are closed for touring on Thanksgiving Day November 26th

facts.fact: Professional photography and video shoots require prior permission.
facts.excerpt: No professional videography or photo shoots are allowed in the Cathedral Basilica without advance permission.

facts.fact: The church identifies an accessible lift on Harris Street.
facts.excerpt: There is an elevator on Harris Street.

facts.fact: Groups must give advance notice, even when not requesting a docent.
facts.excerpt: we require advance notice whether you want us to provide a docent or not.
